page_title: Echolon - The API Client for Modern Developers

sources.entry: Echolon - Open-source API client and Postman alternative.

summary.name: Echolon
summary.one_liner: Echolon is an open-source, local-first API client and Postman alternative with Git integration, offline support, and multi-protocol request handling.
use_cases: testing REST and WebSocket APIs locally
storing API collections in a Git repository
mocking backend responses for frontend work
publishing API documentation to the web
comparing response sizes across compression encodings
migrating collections from Postman or Insomnia
summary.what_it_does: Echolon is a desktop and web API client that saves workspaces, collections, variables and settings as local files. It supports REST/HTTP and WebSocket requests, with GraphQL listed as roadmap. A visual Git interface lets users stage, commit, push, pull, and manage branches. It offers local and cloud mock servers with real-time request monitoring, and can publish API docs to the web with one click. The response viewer previews JSON, XML, HTML and images, supports JSON-Path filtering and OpenAPI schema validation, and shows body size under gzip, brotli and zstd.
notable: Local-first with no account required; collections stored as plain files that work with Git
Built-in visual Git integration with diff viewer and GitHub support
Local and cloud mock servers with 1-click mocking
Response size breakdown comparing uncompressed, gzip, brotli and zstd sizes
caveats: Optional paid features exist for teams and enterprise users; the page says core client is free for personal use
GraphQL support is on the roadmap, not yet available
Page comparison table and FAQ are vendor claims and were not independently verified
